validationType: isolated JavaScript logic checks using a deliberately minimal DOM stub
scope: Design prototype only. No ERP backend, production system or real browser is tested.
limitations: No browser engine or real DOM parser was executed.
CSS layout, visual appearance, responsive behaviour, accessibility and focus are not validated.
FormData and reportValidity are stubbed; native browser validation is not exercised.
Clicks and submissions invoke registered handlers with synthetic events; this does not prove real pointer or keyboard interaction.
No persistence across page reloads, real payments, stock posting, API calls or authorization security is tested.

cases.name: Owner renders all 147 pages and every module landing; emitted page links resolve
Every allowed page renders for all seven roles; role homes are accessible
Restricted initial link and invalid route render safe home
Received is exact, Open retains partial receipts, and cash status groups match
Purchase-order submit creates visible draft with decimal unit cost
Prepending a new indent does not redirect the floor receipt; repeat receipt is blocked
Zero floor receipt is retained with a discrepancy reason
Receipt draft with textual reference never computes a NaN amount
Page-specific generic draft is visible and remains a draft despite typed status
POS underpayment preserves basket; valid payment clears basket and shows exact change
Numeric markup permits zero counts and paise amounts; absent money is a dash
Record note and selected customer are visibly retained within the session
